title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Travel at After-Hours and Emergency Dispatch
content:
Travel dispatch schedule of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours: the travel hours of an onsite date are multiplied according to the bands of that date's onsite-support draws on the block.

| That date's onsite-support draws | Travel hours multiplied by | Band recorded on the travel entry |
|---|---|---|
| include one recorded in the emergency band | the block's emergency multiplier | emergency |
| include none in the emergency band but one in the after-hours or holiday band | the block's after-hours multiplier | after-hours |
| are all in the business-hours band | 1 | business hours |

The travel entry is recorded in the band whose multiplier this schedule applied: emergency for the emergency multiplier, after-hours for the after-hours multiplier, and business hours for a multiplier of 1. A date with a holiday-band visit and no emergency-band visit therefore has its travel drawn at the after-hours multiplier and recorded after-hours.

Hypothetical cases on a TimeBank 40-Hour Block (after-hours multiplier 1.5, emergency multiplier 2.0) with 0.50 travel hours: a date with one business-hours and one emergency-band visit gives 1.00 hour recorded emergency; a date with one holiday-band visit gives 0.75 hour recorded after-hours; a date of business-hours visits only gives 0.50 hour recorded business hours.
